decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the new Small Block and Big Block ticket eligibility windows; no additional update or removal is required.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that secondary royalties fund both prize pools without creating referral tickets.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the Small Block pool amount, trigger, and secondary-royalty contribution; ticket issuance and reset remain owned by the source Requirement.
The candidate's same-message MODIFY already records the Big Block pool target, trigger, and secondary-royalty contribution; ticket issuance and reset remain owned by the source Requirement.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records visibility of both independent ticket counters and permanent badges.
The source explicitly says the existing random-ticket behavior when no referral is used stays identical and does not necessarily redefine that reward as both ticket types.
The source explicitly states that manual claim stays identical, so the ticket-lifecycle change does not alter the collection method.
